name: /help explains the bot in plain language

payload.text:
ℹ️ Tap /start to open the menu, then pick a quiz, task, video challenge, or prize.

Correct quiz answers add 100 points. Wrong answers lose 50, but your balance never goes below zero. Videos need #STrANNIK and 5,000 views.

Need a hand? Send a message to the owner from the menu.
